Issue #60

File Tree Middle Truncation & Hierarchy Overlap Glitch

Phase 1: Workbench Shell & Navigation · Critical · Visual Bug
Real App Capture · Click to enlarge
Defect / Problem Identified
Directory chains were squished into illegible abbreviations (pr... /distribut... /consensu...), and MiddleTruncate container queries caused vertical character overlapping and clipping on folder and file rows.
Engineering Solution
Disabled flattenEmptyDirectories (flattenEmptyDirectories: false) in useFileTree, refactored unsafeCSS to provide balanced LTR flex shrink without negative margin overflow collision, and eliminated empty decoration lane hoarding.
Visual & Architectural Verification
Every nested folder and document renders with crystal-clear full names, proper indent hierarchy, and clean single-line truncation.
